risks.risk: Exact engine make/model and engine code are not readable, so compatibility and correct pricing cannot be confirmed remotely.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/serial plate (usually on block or timing cover) plus the full label area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified used engine with unknown compatibility and unknown condition (worst case: not guaranteed to be correct for the buyer’s application).

risks.risk: “Tested ok” is not evidenced; engine may have internal issues (compression, knocking, overheating) not visible externally.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the engine running (cold start if possible) showing stable idle and no abnormal smoke/noise, or a compression test report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven running/working (worst case: needs overhaul/repair).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect accessories or incomplete parts (alternator, starter, sensors, hoses, ECU) can change value drastically.
risks.proof: A photo checklist: show all major accessories and ports, and confirm what is included (ECU? starter? alternator? turbo? intake/exhaust manifolds?).
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine-only or incomplete/unknown inclusions (worst case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

risks.risk: Shipping/handling damage or cracked components (manifold, block, head) can’t be confirmed from one wide shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the block/head, exhaust manifold area, and any visible cracks/repairs; include underside if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/needs inspection (worst case: repair required).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/serial plate (photo 0 currently doesn’t show readable identifiers).
Video of the engine running (or compression test report / diagnostic printout).
Photos showing what accessories are included (starter, alternator, sensors, intake/exhaust manifolds, turbo if any, ECU/loom if any).
Close-ups of any suspected wear points: head/block surfaces, manifold areas, and any cracks or prior repairs.
response.reason: The item is an engine, but the exact identity and “tested ok” status are not provable from the single photo. Without readable engine code and proof of running/condition, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
